[RDSC.4.6] **Load order is a property of the node graph.** A
reader does not concatenate or order atom bodies to
reconstruct the rule network; the order in which nodes are
linked is carried by the `AlphaNode` / `BetaNode` / `TerminalNode` graph
itself ([RDSC.4a]). A file may therefore split its network
across atoms freely.
